units.source_text: 次日早晨，我同亲戚和村民共六七人前去拾骨。

en.t: The next morning, I went with relatives and villagers, six or seven of us in all, to gather the bones.

units.source_text: 山上的火葬场是露天的。

en.t: The cremation ground on the mountain was in the open air.

units.source_text: 我将骨灰翻了过来，剩下满地的火。

en.t: I turned over the ashes, and fire was left all over the ground.

units.source_text: 在火的熏烤下，我拾了一会儿骨灰。

en.t: Scorched and smoked by the fire, I gathered the ashes for a while.

units.source_text: 鼻血又流淌出来。

en.t: My nose began bleeding again.

units.source_text: 我扔下竹筷，好像还说了一两句什么，就解开了腰带，用带尖堵住鼻子，一溜烟地登上山去，直到山巅。

en.t: I threw down the bamboo chopsticks, apparently said a word or two, then untied my sash, plugged my nose with its end, and rushed up the mountain all the way to the summit.

units.source_text: 跟前天不同，这次血流不止。

en.t: Unlike the day before yesterday, this time the bleeding would not stop.

units.source_text: 半条带子和我的手都沾满了鲜血。

en.t: Half the sash and both my hands were stained with fresh blood.

units.source_text: 血仍然滴滴答答地滴落在草叶上。

en.t: The blood still dripped steadily onto the blades of grass.

units.source_text: 我静静地仰躺下来，往下可以看到山麓的池子。

en.t: I quietly lay down on my back, and below me I could see the pond at the foot of the mountain.

units.source_text: 在水面上跳跃的朝晖，反射在遥远的我身上，使我头晕目眩。

en.t: The morning light dancing on the water reflected back onto me from far below and made me dizzy.

units.source_text: 我从眼睛里感到自己身体的衰弱。

en.t: Through my eyes, I felt the weakness of my own body.

units.source_text: 约莫过了三十分钟，我几次听见人们从远处齐声呼喊我。

en.t: After about thirty minutes, I heard the people calling me in unison from far away several times.

units.source_text: 我的腰带被血濡湿了，尽管腰带是黑色的，我还是生怕别人看见血迹。

en.t: My sash was soaked with blood, and although it was black, I was terribly afraid that others would see the stains.

units.source_text: 于是折回了火葬场。

en.t: So I turned back to the cremation ground.

units.source_text: 人们全都用目光责备我。

en.t: Everyone reproached me with their eyes.

units.source_text: 他们对我说：骨灰出来了，你捡吧。

en.t: They said to me, The ashes are ready; you gather them.

units.source_text: 我带着无法隐瞒的凄楚心情，捡了一丁点骨灰。

en.t: With a grief I could not hide, I picked up a tiny bit of the ashes.

units.source_text: 而后这条湿了又干的变得发硬的腰带一直系在我身上。

en.t: After that, the sash, wet and then dried stiff, remained tied around me the whole time.

units.source_text: 到第二次流鼻血时，谁都不知道就过去了。

en.t: When my nose bled for the second time, it passed without anyone knowing.

units.source_text: 这件事，我后来也没有对别人讲过。

en.t: I never told anyone about this afterward either.

units.source_text: 迄今一次也不曾向别人谈及，也不曾向别人打听过亲人们的事。

en.t: To this day I have never once spoken of it to anyone, nor have I asked anyone about my relatives.
